race.comment: BARBRAY (11) has hit the ground running since taking his talents north. Hasn't had much luck lately chasing from tricky spots but is drawn to get all the favours this time. THE LOUVRE (7) is another in-form runner who sets up well down in the weights. Draws alongside the top pick and will be in this for a long way. MIRRA IMPACT (9) could land in a tricky spot from the low draw but has the turn of foot to cause a big scare if the gaps appear and the pace is genuine. BEAU DAZZLER (1) was far from his best resuming at Eagle Farm but faces an easier assignment second-up and gets a key booking in Thompson. Not taking lightly. CAPITAL ASSET (2) has good early toe and should take hold of the lead. Will prove tough to reel in if left alone through the middle.
